name: Sentinel Onaeya
summary: At Maestra's Post, Sentinel Onaeya guards the northern edge of Ashenvale. The night elf guardian rallies Alliance adventurers to protect the forest and aid fellow sentinels.

sections.title: A Guard on the Frontier
sections.body: Maestra's Post is a wayside outpost on the road from Darkshore into Ashenvale. Sentinel Onaeya guards the lodge outside the settlement and coordinates its defense. Hostile wildlife, corrupting forces, and border tensions threaten night elf settlements in the region.

sections.title: Holding the Post
sections.body: Sentinel Onaeya hears that Sentinel Aynasha was attacked by furbolgs while carrying an important message through Darkshore. Onaeya rewards those who protect the poisoned sentinel until her antidote takes effect.

faq.answer: Sentinel Onaeya is a night elf guardian at Maestra's Post in northwestern Ashenvale. She directs travelers to help defend the outpost.
Sentinel Onaeya stands outside the main building at Maestra's Post, along the northern road in Ashenvale just below the border with Darkshore.

faq.q: What faction does Sentinel Onaeya belong to?
faq.answer: Sentinel Onaeya belongs to the Night Elf Sentinels and is loyal to the Alliance. Horde adventurers find her hostile on sight.

faq.q: How is Onaeya connected to Sentinel Aynasha?
faq.answer: Sentinel Aynasha sends adventurers to report to Onaeya at Maestra's Post after they protect her from attacking furbolgs. Onaeya rewards them and is glad Aynasha survived.

faq.q: What kind of tasks does Sentinel Onaeya give?
faq.answer: Onaeya rewards adventurers who protect Sentinel Aynasha from furbolgs in Darkshore and bring word of her safety to Maestra's Post.

faq.q: Why is Maestra's Post important to the Sentinels?
faq.answer: Maestra's Post is a checkpoint connecting Darkshore's supply routes to Ashenvale's heart. Holding it keeps hostile forces from cutting off night elf travelers moving south.

angles.text: As a night elf traveling south from Darkshore, you find Onaeya on the front line defending Ashenvale woodland from outside threats.
As an Alliance traveler, you can help Onaeya with defensive work as you leave the coastal wilds for Ashenvale's contested forests.
As a Horde traveler, you face Onaeya, a sentinel guarding Maestra's Post and Ashenvale's northern approaches.
